rows.text: SPA, under the dateline Makkah 27 Ramadan 1427 / 19 October 2006, reports a Royal Court statement issued 'today' (اليوم) reproducing Royal Order A/135 dated 26/9/1427 AH, signed by King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz, whose item First issues the Allegiance Commission Law (نظام هيئة البيعة) in the attached form.
rows.locator: Dateline; opening sentence; order number and date; item First; signature; trailer 0511 (05:11 Makkah time)

rows.text: Item Second of Royal Order A/135 amends paragraph (c) of Article 5 of the Basic Law of Governance so that the call to pledge allegiance to the King and the choice of the Crown Prince take place according to the Allegiance Commission Law.
Item Third of Royal Order A/135 applies the Law to future cases and not to the King and Crown Prince in office when it was issued.
